_source: SIA 265:2021, clauses 6.5.2.2 and 6.5.2.3.1 -- transcribed by hand from the German edition, SIA265-2021-DE.pdf pp. 73-74.
_note: The nominal diameter the screws of Tabellen 34 and 35 must have, 6 mm to 12 mm: 6.5.2.2 for wood screws with a cut thread after DIN 7998, 6.5.2.3.1 for rolled or forged threads. Tabellen 36 and 37 are the thicknesses those two tables hold for (6.5.2.2, 6.5.2.3.2), so they apply to that range. 6.5.2.3.1 also bounds the core diameter, 0.6 <= d_1/d <= 0.75.
